description: The Java SDK has two entirely separate error-handling documentation branches with no link between them. howtos/error-handling.md is the general SDK exception-hierarchy page and never mentions transactions. distributed-acid-transactions-from-the-sdk.md's own 'Refer to Error Handling' link points instead to concept-docs/transactions-error-handling.md - a different page the round-4 batch did not extract. A reader who lands on the general error-handling page first has no way to discover that transactions have their own, separately-documented exception pair (TransactionFailedException / TransactionCommitAmbiguousException).
foundDuring: round 4 (Bedrock infra trial, java-sdk transactions batch)
